title: hotfix: slo-enforcer backoff + circuit-breaker tuning to prevent regional thrashing during failover
author: Asha Kumar
description:
Summary: This hotfix adjusts SLO enforcer backoff timings and circuit-breaker thresholds to stop regional thrashing during multi-region failover windows. The symptom we observed in the incident on 2026-02-14 was repeated, rapid cross-region failovers triggered by aggressive SLO enforcement and too-fast circuit-breaker recovery, which caused cascading capacity churn and client errors.

Root cause: The SLO enforcer used a short fixed backoff (30s) for routes failing latency/availability SLOs. During a regional outage, automated regional failover triggered routes to bounce between regions because the enforcer and circuit-breaker recovery windows were misaligned (fast backoff + fast CB half-open). This allowed a route to quickly re-enter traffic in a partially degraded region and immediately fail again, causing thrashing.

What I changed: 1) slo-enforcer/service/backoff_policy.go: increased default backoff to 5m and introduced exponential/backstop behavior; added jitter to avoid synchronized re-evaluation across routing agents. 2) circuit_breaker/thresholds.yaml: raised consecutive-success threshold for CB half-open to reduce premature recovery; add region-aware cooldown to prefer stable healthy regions. 3) infra/terraform/regional-routing.tf: add a routing-stabilize TTL to the regional failover trigger to ensure DNS/route propagation windows align with enforcer backoff. 4) observability/alerts/slo_enforcer.yaml: add alert for 'enforcer-thrashing' (rate of region switches) and SLO regression guardrails. 5) runbooks/regional-failover.md: document rollback and mitigation steps and how to tune thresholds for high-traffic tenants. 6) tests/e2e/regional_failover_test.go: add deterministic test that simulates slow region recovery and asserts no more than one failover per 10 minutes under degraded conditions.

Testing: Unit tests added for backoff policy and CB state transitions. End-to-end test added and run in staging repeatedly for 24h under injected latency — passed. Load test run with regional failover simulation to validate that thrashing does not occur and steady-state capacity is achieved. CI: flaky integration test (routing) was quarantined and re-run; overall CI green after re-run.

Rollout plan: This change was deployed as a hotfix to release-2026-02-15 and rolled out region-by-region with a 30-minute observation window. We monitored 'region switch rate', 'slo-enforcer decisions', and error-rates; metrics were stable after rollout. If regressions are observed, rollback steps are documented in runbooks/regional-failover.md.

Related: Linked Linear items are ENG-8421 (investigate regional thrashing) and SRE-1198 (incident runbook updates).

Notes: This is a behavioral change to SLO enforcement and circuit-breaker defaults. It is intentionally conservative to avoid user-facing regressions. Operators can tune per-tenant via config in charts/slo-enforcer/values.yaml.

release_notes: Hotfix: Increase SLO enforcer backoff and tune circuit-breaker recovery to prevent rapid cross-region failovers and reduce regional thrashing during partial outages. Includes runbook and observability improvements.
